segments.comment: A Samurai loads the bones on D:3. restore.c getlev() reads the light source back with restore_light_sources() and relink_light_sources() points it at the restored lamp. After object detection the Samurai teleports onto the lamp, picks it up and applies it: 'Your lamp is now off.', which ends the burn and deletes that light source.
